trust_decision.summary: Whether a free-form TASK_RUN_COMMAND payload.command (and an MCP STDIO endpoint_or_command) may contain shell chaining/substitution or blocklisted destructive commands before it reaches paramiko exec_command / ansible raw / subprocess.Popen; at the pinned commit nothing is decided: _build_command_text returns payload.command verbatim and it is executed.

landing_point.why: Summary names TASK_RUN_COMMAND, host_tasks.py and paramiko exec_command; the else-branch of _run_single_task_with_ssh passes command_text to execute_remote_command (host_tasks.py:266-267).

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The advisory names TASK_RUN_COMMAND/host_tasks.py/paramiko; MCP STDIO is an admin-configured local process launcher in the aiops package, and the AIOps draft generator only produces a draft that is later executed by the already-fixed host_tasks path.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: K8s pod exec task runs payload.command via /bin/sh -lc inside a pod with no chaining/blocklist check
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Different transport and target (Kubernetes pod via API stream, not paramiko on a host); separate task type TASK_K8S_POD_EXEC.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, ~700 lines below the landing point; reached via start_k8s_task, not execute_host_task

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Playbook task: _validate_remote_command only sees 'ansible-playbook <name>' while payload.playbook_content (which may contain shell/command modules) is executed unchecked
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Playbooks are YAML executed by Ansible, a neighbouring feature with its own task type and approval risk level, not a shell command.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a kubectl exec command-text builder that concatenates payload.command into a shell string
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The module already renders kubectl exec text from payload.command for display; a maintainer could route it to a shell fallback when the k8s client is unavailable.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a scheduled-task path that executes a template command directly via open_ssh_client/execute_remote_command instead of execute_host_task
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Schedules already build HostTask objects from stored payloads; a 'run_now lightweight' shortcut that skips the executor is a plausible refactor (save/reload crossing).

unverified: Fairness concern: the core property is a policy blocklist on a feature whose purpose is running operator commands; exact patterns (e.g. which destructive verbs, npx package allowlist) are not derivable from a short report unless the report states them, so hidden tests must target the definable parts (chaining tokens for run_command without script_purpose; MCP executable allowlist matching built-ins).

Published fix exempts any task whose payload carries script_purpose from the chaining check (fix.diff:271), and payload is client-supplied JSON (backend/ops/serializers.py:81-84); not verified whether the API strips script_purpose.
